warnings: provisional_charter: the user supplied only a URL and a description; business decision, estimand priorities, markets, competitors, surfaces, budget and approver are agent-proposed assumptions and are not human-approved

business_decision: Decide whether assistant answers to real travel-connectivity questions currently surface this travel eSIM marketplace, in which buyer situations and constraint types it is absent, and where evidence is too thin to measure at all - so that content and evidence work can be prioritised for the next two quarters.

estimands.name: unaided_brand_presence
estimands.numerator: Valid eligible answers that mention the target brand or a target-owned product name at least once
estimands.denominator: All valid observations in partitions core and sentinel where aided_status is unaided, within one declared lane, surface, locale and wave
estimands.does_not_prove: Market share, category awareness, audience reach, purchase intent or revenue attribution. It is conditional on this panel and this configuration.

estimands.name: competitive_mention_share
estimands.numerator: Valid eligible answers naming the target, counted against all supplier brands named across those same answers
estimands.denominator: All valid observations in the aided partition where aided_status is category_aided, within one declared lane, surface, locale and wave; competitor_aided cells are reported in their own separate denominator and are never pooled with this one
estimands.does_not_prove: Market share or relative commercial performance. A crowded, affiliate-dense answer set means mention share reflects publishing economics as much as merit.

estimands.name: citation_presence
estimands.numerator: Valid retrieval-lane answers that expose at least one citation resolving to a target-owned domain
estimands.denominator: All valid retrieval-lane observations where retrieval_used is true, within one declared partition, aided_status, surface, locale and wave
estimands.does_not_prove: Referral traffic, click-through or influence on the answer text. Citation exposure varies by surface and is not comparable across surfaces.

estimands.name: aided_brand_knowledge
estimands.numerator: Valid answers that state target attributes consistent with the dated evidence in source_manifest.json for destination, device and plan constraints
estimands.denominator: All valid observations in the aided partition where aided_status is target_aided, within one declared lane, surface, locale and wave
estimands.does_not_prove: That buyers hold the same beliefs, or that the model's stated facts are currently true; every plan, price and coverage fact must be re-verified against a dated source at scoring time.

estimands.name: answer_framing
estimands.numerator: Valid answers whose structure matches the cell's declared expected_answer_kind
estimands.denominator: All valid observations within one canonical cell, lane, surface, locale and wave
estimands.does_not_prove: Buyer preference or persuasion. It records how the assistant frames the answer, not how a person reacts to it.

target_population: People who ask a general-purpose AI assistant, in English, how to obtain mobile data while travelling outside their home country, in the situations evidenced in buyer_jobs.json. This is a declared analytical population, not a probability sample of AI users.
exclusions: Non-English prompts: no buyer-language evidence and no native reviewer available
Business, affiliate and reseller partner buyers (icp-006): company-asserted evidence only
In-app and on-device assistant surfaces that cannot be run with a declared session state
Voice-first assistants: no evidence base and no comparable parser
Any campaign-exposed measurement: no campaign supplied
Enterprise/IoT connectivity buyers: outside the described perimeter

products.gap_note: No independent or behavioural buyer language specific to multi-continent global plans was retrieved; global coverage is measured only through the regional-versus-global comparison cell. Evidence needed: forum or review language from travellers choosing a global plan.

products.area: plan constraint (data volume, unlimited fair use, validity, top-up)

products.gap_note: Waiver W-002. Company-asserted evidence only (source-001, source-002). Evidence needed: independent partner-side sources or authorised customer evidence before any cell is created.
Waiver W-003. Company-asserted only; no buyer language found. Also a campaign-adjacent term class held out of unaided measurement.

markets: global outbound leisure travel, measured from en-US and en-CA prompting contexts only
time_horizon: One quarter of waves from first run, with monthly evidence intake and a quarterly panel review

lane_policies.closed_model: No external retrieval, tools, files, RAG or conversation history. Fixed model/version, fixed system prompt, fixed sampling settings, fresh session per observation.
lane_policies.retrieval: Retrieval allowed. Record retrieval_used, generated queries when exposed, live/cached state and all exposed citation metadata. Never pool with closed_model.
lane_policies.consumer_surface: Clean, logged-out or declared archetype account, declared device and locale, personalisation and history state recorded. Never rolled up with API observations.
lane_policies.campaign_experiment: Not instantiated in this version. No campaign wording, treatment set or matched control exists; a campaign lane requires pre-registration before any cell is created.

surface-consumer-clean.note: Sentinel cells only in this version, because manual collection cost limits volume.

run_budget.basis: 639 planned observations per wave (see panel.yaml budget.calculation) plus headroom of roughly 10 percent for retries on invalid runs

review_budget.basis: Manual scoring of ambiguous mention/citation cases, consumer-surface collection, and B5 decay review
